content: What structural engineers expect from a model viewer: (1) immediate framing of the whole model on open (camera fit to bounds), (2) color-by-section/group/material as a first-class display mode (STAAD.Pro Color By, SCIA color by material/cross-section/layer, Midas display options), (3) supports visualized as restraint icons at nodes (toggleable, STAAD.Pro Supports display), (4) load arrows with direction + magnitude labels, per-load-case selection (STAAD.Pro Load Values, Midas load case selector), (5) tap/click any member to inspect section name, dimensions, start/end node coordinates, group, length (OpenBuilding info panel, Structural Navigator query, STAAD.Pro beam spec), (6) model statistics (node/member counts, units) - STAAD.Pro Info tab shows counts + file info, (7) node numbers and member numbers as toggleable labels, (8) size exaggeration for thin members (STAAD.Pro renders 3D sections with adjustable display), (9) view modes solid/wireframe/x-ray, (10) mobile: multitouch orbit/zoom/pan is expected and 'arguably better than a mouse' for inspection (CalcSteel), field review workflow = view + query + measure, no editing.
